summary.text: Steve Tyson is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 3 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A U.S. Army veteran and business owner, he has worked as a general contractor and real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Steve Tyson served in the United States Army.
His career experience includes work as a general contractor and a real estate broker, and owning a business.

Ballotpedia lists his board service as including Carolina East Medical Center, the Craven100 Economic Development Alliance, the Tryon Palace Commission, and the New Bern Chamber of Commerce Military Affairs Committee.
Tyson assumed office in the state House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Michael Speciale.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Finance Committee and the House Transportation Committee and was vice chair of the Commerce Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
